_note: INTERNAL. One entry per supplier product the business can source a riser doorset against. internalName and _source are for the sales team and must NEVER be rendered customer-side — the customer sees an MF Services doorset; which supplier fulfils it is resolved by the matching engine from what the customer asks for. Evidence is referenced by report id into fire-test-reports.json. priority breaks ties when more than one product matches at the same evidence level (lower number wins).

products._source: integra4000frpafmda360r2 datasheet + fire test reports XL070-17&18 / XL070-13&14 (Access 360 sponsored).
products._acoustic: All-in-one acoustic/intumescent/smoke seal fitted; no dB figure published on the datasheet. Acoustic requirements route to enquiry for this product until a certificate is held.

statedLimits._source: Datasheet: 'maximum leaf height of 3100 mm'. No stated width cap published; width past evidence is treated as stated-only, and past 1400 mm per leaf as enquiry.

clearOpening._source: Datasheet CAD: structural opening = X + 15, clear opening = X − 120 (width). Height deduction not legible on the sheet — assumed equal and flagged unconfirmed; confirm against the manufacturing drawing before order.

products.construction: 1.5 mm frame and 1.2 mm door in electro-galvanised mild steel. Fully welded frame with factory-applied intumescent strips. Rockwool core door leaf with 12.5 mm fire board backing. All-in-one acoustic, intumescent and smoke seal. Concealed continuous piano hinge. Concealed multi-point locking.

products._source: vega1500seriesdatasheet. No test report for this product is held — its stated maxima (2750 mm @ 938 wide / 1035 wide @ 2493 high) are Annex-B-shaped corners from a report we have requested and do not hold.

statedLimits._source: Datasheet corners: max height 2750 @ 938 wide, max width 1035 @ 2493 high. Encoded as linear caps plus an area cap so the corner shape is respected.

clearOpening._source: Datasheet CAD: structural opening = X + 10, clear opening = X − 70 (width). Height assumed equal and flagged unconfirmed.

products.hinge: Quick-release pivot hinge with retractable flush bolt
products.construction: 1.2 mm door and frame in electro-galvanised mild steel. Fully welded four-sided frame with factory-applied intumescent strips. Lightweight Rockwool core door leaf (24 kg/m²). All-in-one acoustic, intumescent and smoke seal. Quick-release pivot hinge with retractable flush bolt. Multi-point locking.

products._source: The supplier literature the tool was originally built from. Its published corner (938 × 2750) matches the VEGA sheet and its specimen matches report XL070-17&18, so it is very likely the same product family rebadged — confirm with the supplier. Until then it keeps its own limits and the one report whose specimen it quotes.
products.hinge: Quick-release heavy-duty pivot hinges welded into the door trays
products.construction: Steel skins to both faces over an insulated strengthened core, 100 mm thick. Door tray and frame in 1.0 and 1.2 mm Zintec electro-galvanised mild steel. Quick-release heavy-duty pivot hinges welded into the door trays. Multiple-point locking to the active leaf.
